scope: Normative acceptance targets for the common tree grouper and distinct Expression application adapter; not runtime-executed by publication checks

architecture.grouper: Resolve priorities, groups and explicit field streams in the supplied pure graph, including references consumed as CODE/Expression. Notation, source origin and parenthesis history are not semantic flags. Produce a structured current-level operation/stream plan without rewriting or reparsing text.
architecture.application_adapter: Package the left side as one actual and the current-level right stream as an Array of references under the receiving ABI. This packaging belongs to the application adapter, not the grouper.
architecture.collector: RxLogicalArguments and library asOperand forward the projected actual vector; no element traversal, reverse packing or additional opening pass.
architecture.roles: VALUE/TYPE/DATA and whole-value contracts do not become CODE automatically. In CODE/Expression, an ordinary named Structure with the current lexical parent follows the ordinary call path; a named Structure with a different parent and every anonymous Structure are handled as graph groups, retaining their real parent. Name/actual-parent relative to traversal owner determines the branch, not reference provenance. Planning does not run DATA or force RAW.
architecture.graph_references: Consume the supplied pure graph under its receiving role. In CODE/Expression: named + current lexical parent means ordinary call; named + other parent means group; anonymous means group. Preserve actual parent and binding context; do not use source-origin or parenthesis flags.

p0: Preserve graph identities, structural levels and diagnostic provenance; no parenthesis/source-origin flag participates in semantics and no replacement graph or textual reparse is produced
former_rule_status: Accepted argument-vector observations are corollaries of grouping plus application ABI; there is no independent conditional-opening pass
callable_we: Its established ordinary call-selection contract is unchanged

right_elements: factory() result as one value in prepared mode; original call in raw mode
cases.receiving_contract: This control receives the call result as one whole VALUE; explicit RAW retains the complete call graph. It does not forbid consuming a graph through a separately selected CODE/Expression contract.

right_elements: S as one whole Structure under the selected value/type/data contract
cases.receiving_contract: This control explicitly admits S as one whole VALUE/TYPE/DATA actual. It is not a blanket rule excluding referenced graphs from CODE/Expression grouping.

cases.grouper_plan: left stream a,b,c; assignment operation; right current-level stream a,c,b

cases.source: (a b c) := (f g h) (f g h) (f g h)
cases.grouper_plan: left stream a,b,c; assignment operation; three right Structure values at the current level

cases.fixture: d has three immediate ready fields with values 4,5,6
cases.grouper_plan: explicit copy field stream, with no required enclosing RHS group
cases.writes: obtain the complete ordinary assignment snapshot before any destination write
cases.whole_value_control: scalar := (copy(d)) remains one whole Structure under the scalar contract

required_controls: Project only the selected current-level stream; do not descend into every Structure value
Application adaptation packages left as one actual; the grouper itself does not perform left packaging
RxLogicalArguments and asOperand consume the prepared vector without opening its elements
No eager evaluation of DATA or RAW to discover groups

Consume the supplied pure graph under its receiving role. In CODE/Expression: named + current lexical parent means ordinary call; named + other parent means group; anonymous means group. Preserve actual parent and binding context; do not use source-origin or parenthesis flags.
Explicit field streams and receiver-specific list contracts remain distinct from automatic value spreading

parent_cases.expected: Treat S as the same group shape as direct (a b c d), preserving its actual parent and context; this branch creates no call activation.
Use the ordinary named-Structure call path and its admission; do not silently inline it as a foreign-parent group.

parent_cases.actual_parent: current lexical parent or another parent
parent_cases.expected: An anonymous Structure remains a group; execution, when required by CODE/Expression, is in place rather than a named call.

code_graph_reference_control.numeric_result: Not asserted: four neighboring atoms do not automatically form a numeric expression; + admission and any ordinary call result are checked separately.
code_graph_reference_control.value_boundary: A Structure admitted in a VALUE/TYPE/DATA position remains under that contract, regardless of its name or parent; the CODE classification is not applied automatically there.
code_graph_reference_control.provenance: Source spelling/origin and P0 diagnostic provenance do not decide the branch.

displayed_source_scope: Source spellings and written_right_occurrences describe fixtures for readers and diagnostics only. Actual grouping follows the passed graph and receiving contract, not how that graph was written or obtained.
